name: Seattle
tagline: Pike Place, the Space Needle and mountain views
summary: A green, waterfront city between Puget Sound and the Cascade mountains. See the fish fly at Pike Place Market, ride up the Space Needle, take a ferry across the Sound, and on clear days look up at Mount Rainier.
seasonNote: July to September is dry and sunny, the peak season. The rest of the year is mild and often drizzly.
arrival: Sea-Tac Airport is 40 minutes from Downtown on the Link light rail.
gettingAround: Light rail, buses and the monorail; Downtown is walkable but hilly.
foodTip: Fresh salmon and Dungeness crab, oysters, teriyaki, and coffee everywhere.
buyTip: Smoked salmon from Pike Place, local coffee and outdoor gear.
baseArea: Downtown or Belltown near Pike Place
